lab1.Laboratorio 1 · Gemelo digital de una fá: Lab 1 · Digital Twin of a Smart Factory
lab1.Gemelo digital de una fábrica inteligent: Digital twin of a smart factory
lab1.Simulá una línea de producción automotri: Simulate an automotive production line. Explore how availability, performance, quality, buffers and disruptions determine actual output.

lab1.Producción acumulada · conformes y recha: Cumulative output · good units and rejects
lab1.La simulación permite identificar restri: The simulation helps identify constraints and explain why a technology investment does not always increase final output.
lab1.Iniciá la simulación para observar cómo: Start the simulation to observe the line. Change scenarios to compare automation, failures and bottlenecks.
lab1.Los controles se aplican en tiempo real,: Controls take effect in real time; no reset is required.
lab1.proporción del tiempo planificado en que: share of planned production time during which the bottleneck station is available.

lab1.proporción de vehículos terminados que c: share of completed vehicles that meet quality requirements.

lab1.Usá los escenarios para responderlas con: Use the scenarios to answer these questions with evidence from the simulation.

lab1.¿Cuánto mejora la producción al incorpor: How much does output improve when predictive maintenance is introduced?
lab1.¿Qué efecto tiene reducir la capacidad d: What is the effect of reducing buffer capacity?
lab1.¿Puede aumentar el OEE mientras cae la p: Can OEE increase while good output falls?

lab2.Laboratorio 2 | 6G y computación cuántic: Lab 2 | 6G and Quantum Computing · Technological China
lab2.Dos simuladores en una sola aplicación:: Two simulators in one application: explore capacity and latency in intelligent networks, then build quantum circuits, prepare entangled states and measure their outcomes.
lab2.Compará 5G y una arquitectura 6G hipotét: Compare 5G with a hypothetical 6G architecture under the same demand and observe congestion, capacity and service failures.
lab2.Esquema conceptual. No representa una ar: Conceptual diagram. It does not represent a deployed commercial architecture.
lab2.Elegí un escenario e iniciá la simulació: Choose a scenario and start the simulation.
lab2.La latencia total suma una componente fi: Total latency combines a hypothetical fixed transport/processing component with waiting and service time from the queueing model. If demand exceeds capacity, the simulator displays an overload and loss approximation; the steady-state M/M/1 formula is no longer used.
lab2.las diferencias entre 5G y 6G son supues: The differences between 5G and 6G are adjustable teaching assumptions. They are not verified network measurements or promises of real latency. Satellite networks are also constrained by propagation, obstacles and coverage.
lab2.Los valores cambian en vivo; la dinámica: Values change live; the simulation introduces reproducible traffic fluctuations.
lab2.La arquitectura 6G ilustrada contempla c: The illustrated 6G architecture includes integrated communications, AI and distributed processing. Lower latency does not depend only on the mobile generation; it also depends on service capacity, distance, interference and congestion.
lab2.; ITU-R M.2160 (marco IMT-2030). Las cif: ; ITU-R M.2160 (IMT-2030 framework). Simulator values are synthetic.
lab2.Manipulá estados de uno o dos qubits, ap: Manipulate one- or two-qubit states, apply unitary operations, inspect probabilities and perform measurements.
The history shows the order of applied gates. States are calculated with complex amplitudes; noise is added only during sampling.
lab2.Prepará un estado y aplicá puertas para: Prepare a state and apply gates to observe how its probabilities evolve.
lab2.mezcla uniforme simplificada en la distr: simplified uniform mixture in the measurement distribution
lab2.. Jiuzhang es un sistema fotónico especi: . Jiuzhang is a specialized photonic system; this gate model does not reproduce its boson-sampling experiments.
lab2.Aplicá puertas unitarias al qubit selecc: Apply unitary gates to the selected qubit. CNOT is enabled when using two qubits.
lab2.Prepará |0⟩ y aplicá H. La medición debe: Prepare |0⟩ and apply H. Measurement should approach 50% for 0 and 50% for 1.
lab2.Prepará el estado de Bell: los resultado: Prepare a Bell state: outcomes 00 and 11 should each appear close to 50%, with no 01 or 10 in the absence of noise.
lab2.Aumentá el ruido y compará cómo cambia l: Increase noise and compare how the measurement distribution changes while keeping ideal unitary evolution unchanged.
lab2.Aplicá Z a |+⟩. Aunque la distribución n: Apply Z to |+⟩. The distribution does not change immediately, but the relative phase does; the effect appears after another H.
lab2.Modelo didáctico con supuestos explícito: Educational model with explicit assumptions · Synthetic simulations, not manufacturer performance data.
lab2.Demanda actual: ${format(m.demand,0)} so: Current demand: ${format(m.demand,0)} requests/s. 5G capacity: ${format(m.mu5,0)}/s; hypothetical 6G capacity: ${format(m.mu6,0)}/s.
lab2.Existe sobrecarga: la pérdida se estima: Overload is present: loss is estimated as the share of demand exceeding capacity.
lab2.Ambos servicios están dentro de su capac: Both services are within capacity; queue latency rises as saturation approaches.

lab3.Laboratorio 3 · Neurotecnología, biotecn: Lab 3 · Neurotechnology, Biotechnology and AI for Science
lab3.Neurotecnología, biotecnología e IA para: Neurotechnology, biotechnology and AI for science
lab3.Dos fronteras de convergencia: decodific: Two converging frontiers: decoding neural signals to control devices, and using AI models to explore biological candidates that require experimental validation.
lab3.AI for Science y aprendizaje activo: AI for Science and active learning
lab3.Laboratorio A · Del patrón neuronal a la: Lab A · From neural pattern to action
lab3.Clasificá dos clases de imaginación moto: Classify two motor-imagery classes using fully synthetic EEG signals.
lab3.un flujo conceptual BCI: adquisición → e: a conceptual BCI pipeline: acquisition → feature extraction → classification → control command. These are not clinical recordings, NEO implant data or a medical tool.
lab3.Más sensible a clase derecha: More sensitive to the right class
Class 0: left-hand motor imagery. Class 1: right-hand motor imagery. Values are calculated on held-out test data.
lab3.Relación entre el modelo simulado y la a: How the simulated model relates to the conceptual architecture in slide deck 3.
lab3.EEG sintético en C3 y C4: Synthetic EEG at C3 and C4
lab3.La señal se resume mediante cuatro carac: The signal is summarized by four features: mu-band power (8–13 Hz) and beta-band power (14–28 Hz) in two simulated channels. The classifier learns statistical patterns, not free-form thoughts.
lab3.Elegí una observación del conjunto de pr: Select a test-set observation to inspect its classification.
lab3.Entrená el modelo para visualizar la int: Train the model to display the interpretation.
lab3.Las características se estandarizan usan: Features are standardized using the training set only. The threshold converts probability into a class. The ROC curve evaluates multiple thresholds.
lab3.Una BCI real requiere protocolos, calibr: A real BCI requires protocols, individual calibration, clinical evaluation and risk management. This simulation only illustrates a processing pipeline.
lab3.El caso NEO se presenta como aplicación: The NEO case is presented as a specific clinical application, not general brain reading.
lab3.La simulación no reproduce NEO ni atribu: The simulation does not reproduce NEO or attribute accuracy metrics to the device.
lab3.Laboratorio B · Diseño molecular y apren: Lab B · Molecular design and active learning
lab3.Simulá un ciclo de diseño, selección, en: Simulate a cycle of design, selection, testing and predictive-model updating.
lab3.los candidatos y sus resultados son comp: Candidates and results are entirely synthetic. No protein sequences are generated, no real affinity is predicted and no biological assay is replaced. The goal is to study experimental-selection strategies.
lab3.Comparación de estrategias · mejor activ: Strategy comparison · mean best observed activity
lab3.Seleccioná una fila para inspeccionar su: Select a row to inspect its descriptors and decide whether to test it.
lab3.Una IA amplía el espacio de búsqueda; el: AI expands the search space; experiments produce evidence.
lab3.Actualizar modelo y volver a decidir: Update the model and decide again
lab3.Este laboratorio modela la etapa de sele: This laboratory models candidate selection and experimentation, not protein folding or real molecular interactions.
lab3.riesgo sintético; λ controla su penaliza: synthetic risk; λ controls its penalty.
lab3.El proceso gaussiano usa un kernel RBF s: The Gaussian process uses an RBF kernel over normalized descriptors. True activity remains hidden until the simulated experiment is run.
lab3.La simulación se inspira en el ciclo met: The simulation is inspired by the methodological cycle; it does not reproduce these platforms.
lab3.Ingeniería proteica con restricciones es: Protein engineering with structural and evolutionary constraints.
lab3.Sistema de modelos y agentes de apoyo a: A system of models and agents supporting multidisciplinary research.
lab3.Ministerio de Industria y Tecnología de: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
Do not conflate these levels of evidence.

lab4.Laboratorio 4 · China 2030: drones, espa: Lab 4 · China 2030: Drones, Space and Energy
lab4.Explorá cómo se construyen nuevas indust: Explore how emerging industries are built from aircraft, satellite navigation, orbital infrastructure and energy technologies. Change assumptions, run scenarios and assess their economic and technical limits.
lab4.Administrá una flota, asigná misiones y: Manage a fleet, assign missions and observe how range, demand, weather, infrastructure and regulation interact.
lab4.simula una operación urbana ficticia. No: simulates a fictional urban operation. It does not represent authorized routes, certified performance or operational data from EHang or CAAC. Aircraft certification does not imply an unrestricted air-taxi network.
lab4.Producción acumulada y demanda pendiente: Cumulative completed missions and pending demand
lab4.Cadena de valor: una aeronave no crea un: Value chain: an aircraft does not create an industry by itself
lab4.Iniciá el turno para observar la interac: Start the shift to observe the interaction between demand, capacity and charging.
lab4.Un servicio se habilita cuando cumple si: A service is enabled only when all model conditions are met.
lab4.Energía suficiente para ida, vuelta y re: Enough energy for the outbound leg, return leg and reserve.
lab4.Disponibilidad de puestos de carga y ope: Availability of charging and operating facilities.
lab4.El clima aumenta consumo y probabilidad: Weather increases energy consumption and incident probability.
lab4.Una fracción de misiones puede quedar bl: Some missions may be blocked by operational restrictions.
lab4.Hito presentado en el PPT 4: distinguir: Milestone covered in slide deck 4: distinguish certification from operation.
lab4.Los certificados habilitan etapas difere: The certificates authorize different stages; they do not, by themselves, imply an unrestricted nationwide air-taxi network.
lab4.Laboratorio B · BeiDou: posicionamiento,: Lab B · BeiDou: Positioning, Navigation and Timing
lab4.Explorá cómo visibilidad satelital, obst: Explore how satellite visibility, obstructions and multipath affect a PNT service.
lab4.este es un modelo geométrico y estadísti: this is a simplified geometric and statistical model. It does not reproduce the real BeiDou constellation, coverage, signals or performance; values must not be interpreted as official specifications.
lab4.De la órbita al servicio: cadena de valo: From orbit to service: the space value chain
lab4.El valor económico no termina en el lanz: Economic value does not end at launch; it depends on turning data into useful applications.
Calculate how it moves and in which direction.
lab4.Sincronizar redes, transacciones y siste: Synchronize networks, transactions and critical systems.
lab4.Cuatro satélites son una regla didáctica: Four satellites are a simplified teaching rule for solving three-dimensional position and clock offset; actual quality depends on geometry, signal, receiver and environment.
lab4.Objetivo de la siguiente fase de la misi: Objective of the next mission phase.
lab4.El retorno de muestras es un objetivo fu: Sample return is a future objective, not an outcome already achieved.
lab4.¿Por qué una constelación de satélites n: Why does a satellite constellation not automatically create economic value?
lab4.¿Qué infraestructura complementaria nece: What complementary infrastructure does a PNT service need for drones, logistics or electric grids?
lab4.¿Qué diferencias existen entre disponibi: What is the difference between availability, accuracy and integrity?
lab4.Calculá producción diaria, costo energét: Calculate daily hydrogen output, energy cost and emissions from electricity input.
lab4.el hidrógeno es un vector energético. La: hydrogen is an energy carrier. Electrolysis converts electricity and water into hydrogen and oxygen; its footprint depends on the electricity source, efficiency and equipment utilization.
lab4.Laboratorio C2 · Fusión: el desafío del: Lab C2 · Fusion: the confinement challenge
lab4.Explorá el producto triple de Lawson com: Explore the Lawson triple product as a conceptual physical indicator.
lab4.la duración de un pulso de plasma no es: plasma pulse duration is not the same as energy confinement time. The EAST duration record cited in the slide deck must not be interpreted as a measurement of τ
lab4.Producto triple al variar el confinamien: Triple product as energy confinement varies
lab4.La producción física no determina por sí: Physical output alone does not determine competitiveness.
lab4.kg H₂/día = (MW × 1.000 × 24 × utilizaci: kg H₂/day = (MW × 1,000 × 24 × utilization) / kWh per kg
lab4.El costo mostrado suma electricidad y ot: The displayed cost adds electricity and other variable costs entered by the user. It excludes CAPEX, financing, compression, storage, transport, taxes and grid-connection costs.
lab4.La electrólisis no es automáticamente li: Electrolysis is not automatically emissions-free: the input electricity determines much of its footprint.
lab4.Producto triple simplificado: densidad ×: Simplified triple product: density × temperature × energy confinement time.
lab4.El indicador se compara con un valor de: The indicator is compared with an illustrative reference value of about 3 × 10²¹ keV·s·m⁻³ for a D-T reference condition. The exact criterion depends on the regime, composition, impurities and full energy balance.
lab4.Superar el indicador no demuestra ignici: Exceeding the indicator does not demonstrate ignition, net engineering gain or power-plant viability.
lab4.Hitos de energía citados en el PPT 4: Energy milestones cited in slide deck 4
lab4.Son datos de contexto presentados en el: These are contextual figures in the slide deck: an experimental plasma record is not commercial electricity, and installed electrolysis capacity is not actual production.

labSdv.Latencia y detención · China tecnológica: Latency and Stopping Distance · Technological China
labSdv.Explorá cómo la velocidad, el tiempo de: Explore how speed, response time and tire-road friction affect an idealized model. Compare prediction and result before changing each parameter.
labSdv.v = velocidad / 3,6 en m/s. Distancia de: v = speed / 3.6 in m/s. Response distance dᵣ = v × t. Braking distance dբ = v² / (2μg), with g = 9.81 m/s². Ideal stopping distance d = dᵣ + dբ. The chart shows the quadratic effect of speed and the linear effect of response time.
labSdv.Registrar el resultado base y formular q: Record the baseline result and predict what happens when speed doubles.
labSdv.Reducir el tiempo de respuesta a cero. ¿: Set response time to zero. Does braking distance disappear?
labSdv.Comparar adherencia 0,7 y 0,2. Explicar: Compare friction coefficients 0.7 and 0.2. Explain why faster software does not remove the physical limit.
Export the results and justify every unit.
labSdv.Supuestos: piso horizontal, desaceleraci: Assumptions: level road, constant deceleration μg after the response, no aerodynamics, slope, sensor failures or vehicle dynamics. This does not represent a specific ADAS system or determine safe real-world driving distances.
